note: Both sets capture the main region behavior (blade pitch 0° in Region 2, TSR falling from ~20 at 3 m/s to ~3 at 25 m/s, 15 MW rated power, CP ≈ 0.5 in Region 2) and both recycle several claims verbatim. Set B additionally captures the printed Design Point CT = 0.804 and the blade pitch at 25 m/s (~23°), which Set A omits even though it repeats Design Point CP = 0.489 three times. Set A's main defect is three mutually inconsistent rotor-thrust values at 10 m/s (2.25, 2.8, and a "peak" 3.0 MN, when the curve peaks just under 3.00 MN near 10.5 m/s) plus 15 MW assigned to 10 m/s, while Set B's clear errors are the 10-RPM rotor speed at 10 m/s (the curve plateaus near 7.5 RPM) and a 22° pitch at 25 m/s contradicting its own 23° claim. On balance B covers more of the page's stated facts with slightly fewer misreadings.
